schedules.name: primary
schedules.function: discover, classify, hash, reconcile, custody-check, register, and hand off new PentaBooks artifacts

schedules.name: cold_recovery
schedules.function: retry missed artifacts, stale readbacks, dead-lettered handoffs, and provider drift without duplicating accepted events

write_policy: append-only evidence; update projections only after source evidence is immutable
secret_policy: Use vault aliases or repository/provider secret names only. Never serialize secret values into logs, manifests, Drive, PentaDocs, or product packages.
